guide.title: Inventory Guide
guide.description: Learn how to manage your inventory step by step
guide.allDone: You completed all steps! You're ready to manage inventory.
guide.allDoneDescription: You can reset your progress to review the guide again.

1.title: Set up Products
1.description: Start by creating products and their variants. Each product (frame, drops, contact lens) needs at least one variant with a SKU and sell price. You can also define packaging units (piece, box, carton) with conversion factors.
1.tip: Use clear variant names like '-2.00' or '5ml' or 'Blue/Large' to make searching easier later.

2.title: Add Suppliers
2.description: Register the suppliers you deal with. For each supplier: name, phone, address, and an opening balance if you have prior debts. Suppliers are required for purchase orders and batch tracking.
2.tip: Enter the supplier's opening balance if you had prior debts before using the system.

3.title: Enter Opening Stock
3.description: Enter the quantities currently in the clinic via the 'Opening Stock' button in the Stock Movements tab. An OPENING batch will be created for each variant with unit cost and received date.
3.tip: Count the physical stock before entering. You can enter opening stock for each variant separately.

4.title: Create a Purchase Order
4.description: When you need to order goods from a supplier, create a purchase order. Specify the supplier, items, quantities, and prices. A purchase order starts as 'draft' then you convert it to 'ordered'.
4.tip: You can edit a purchase order before converting it to 'ordered'. After that, it cannot be edited.

5.title: Receive Purchase Order (Inbound)
5.description: When goods arrive, click 'Receive' on the purchase order. This will: create a batch for each item, generate an inbound stock movement, update stock automatically, and update the supplier account.
5.tip: Verify that received quantities match the ordered ones. You can receive less than ordered (partial receipt).

6.title: Selling and Dispensing (Outbound)
6.description: Selling happens through invoices: when you create an invoice with an item linked to a product variant, stock is deducted automatically (FIFO/FEFO). Consumables are also auto-deducted in examinations based on consumable rules.
6.tip: Add consumable rules in the 'Exam Consumables' tab to auto-deduct drops and papers on each examination.

7.title: Handle Damage and Expiry
7.description: When an item is damaged or expired, record an outbound movement via 'Record Damage' or 'Record Expiry'. The quantity will be deducted from stock and the cost recorded as a loss in profit/loss reports.
7.tip: Review stock alerts regularly — the system alerts you about products expiring within 30 days.

8.title: Periodic Stocktaking & Reports
8.description: Perform periodic physical stocktaking via the 'Stocktaking' tab: start a session, count actual quantities, then complete to auto-adjust differences. Review inventory reports (stock value, profit/loss, stock movements) in the Reports page.
8.tip: Conduct stocktaking at least monthly. Stocktaking generates adjustment movements automatically for discrepancies.
